source.annotations: Schlegel, Bates, et al. Nature (2024) - cell types, sides, soma coordinates
source.neurotransmitters: Eckstein, Bates, et al. Cell 187(10), 2574-2594 (2024) - per-neuron top_nt -> excitatory/inhibitory sign

model.type: leaky integrate-and-fire (alpha-synapse), as implemented in the paper (Brian2)

graph.note: every neuron-pair with >=1 published synapse is included

positions.space: FlyWire (FAFB14) volume, nanometres, as published in the FlyWire annotation table
positions.note: These are the real annotated soma coordinates. They are NOT transformed into any atlas (e.g. JRC2018U) space, so this bundle must not be drawn inside an atlas mesh without an explicit, cited transform.
